opportunity.title: DHA PAE DMS EIDS PMO Data Exchange Services Operations, Modernization, and Development (AOI 02)
opportunity.noticeType: Solicitation (Commercial Solutions Opening area of interest)
opportunity.description: Defense Health Agency PAE Digital Medical Solutions, EIDS PMO, seeks commercial solutions for Data Exchange Platform (DxP) operations, sustainment, modernization and development. The DxP processes real-time clinical and operational data exchanged with more than 15 external systems and partners and enables secure, standards-based interoperability among DHA, the Department of Veterans Affairs and other federal healthcare partners. The Government wants reliable, secure, continuously available legacy services while modernizing toward scalable, cloud-native, API-driven, standards-based and AI/ML-ready capabilities. Issued under DHA Commercial Solutions Opening HT003826SC005. No set-aside used.

rationale.point: The opportunity directly involves operating, sustaining, modernizing, and developing a data exchange platform for the Defense Health Agency, which aligns with Atlas Federal's proven past performance on a Defense Health Agency data program.

The opportunity is open to full-and-open competition (set-aside NONE) with a due date of October 28, 2026, giving Atlas Federal ample time to prepare a competitive proposal leveraging its 400 staff, 150 cleared personnel, Top Secret facility clearance, and FedRAMP Moderate authorization.

risks: Estimated value of $500K+ is significantly below Atlas Federal's typical prime contract range ($5M–$60M), which may affect pricing competitiveness or strategic prioritization.
High competition expected for Defense Health Agency IT work; other large businesses with similar clearances and past performance will likely bid.
nextSteps: Obtain and review the full RFP when released to confirm scope, evaluation criteria, and any mandatory requirements.
Assemble a capture team including cleared personnel with relevant Defense Health Agency data exchange experience.
Develop past performance narratives highlighting the Defense Health Agency data program and other DoD IT prime contracts.
Conduct a pricing analysis to ensure competitiveness at the $500K+ level while maintaining margins.
Monitor SAM.gov for amendments, Q&A, and industry day announcements.
